# ⚡ non-functional-testing

Accessibility, performance and load, and application security testing.

Install: `non-functional-testing@jaktestowac`. See the [quick start](https://github.com/jaktestowac/awesome-agents-for-quality#-quick-start) for each tool.

## Skills

- [`auditing-accessibility`](skills/auditing-accessibility/SKILL.md)
- [`testing-performance-and-load`](skills/testing-performance-and-load/SKILL.md)
- [`testing-application-security`](skills/testing-application-security/SKILL.md)

## Commands

Run these yourself: `/name` in Claude Code and GitHub Copilot, `$name` in Codex. The agent never starts them on its own.

- [`a11y-webpage-audit`](skills/a11y-webpage-audit/SKILL.md): A11y webpage audit (single URL)
- [`a11y-audit-deep-dive`](skills/a11y-audit-deep-dive/SKILL.md): Accessibility audit - deep dive
- [`performance-reliability-plan`](skills/performance-reliability-plan/SKILL.md): Performance and reliability test planner

## Agents

| Agent | Claude Code | GitHub Copilot | Codex |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Accessibility Expert | [`accessibility-expert`](agents/accessibility-expert.md) | [`accessibility-expert`](.github/agents/accessibility-expert.agent.md) | [`accessibility_expert`](codex/agents/accessibility-expert.toml) |

Claude Code and GitHub Copilot load these agents with the plugin.
Codex does not load agents from plugins: copy the files from [`codex/agents/`](codex/agents/) into your project's `.codex/agents/` or into `~/.codex/agents/`.

## MCP servers

- `playwright`: `npx @playwright/mcp@latest`

Claude Code and Codex start these from the plugin. In GitHub Copilot, add them to your MCP configuration yourself.
